population.exclusions: Record unsupported share actions, calendar/price gaps and unresolved authority before performance; retain original eight-symbol denominator.

windows.boundary_policy: One continuous 2019-2023 portfolio path; half-year windows describe that same path and retain holdings/cash/receivables across boundaries. No reset, parameter selection or OOS claim. Terminal positions remain marked and reported unrealized, never fabricated as liquidated.

signals.atr: Wilder; first TR=high-low; arithmetic seed; fixed final 240 bars for ATR14
signals.corporate_actions: Adjust each historical window to its own signal session: prior OHLC multiply price_factor; prior volume multiply share_factor (new shares / old shares). Never anchor to future actions.
signals.missing_event_known_at: Default blocks. Explicit allow_reconstructed_history with official_effective_date_reconstruction permits retrospective effective-date research only; does not establish historical knowledge/PIT verification.
signals.execution_eligibility: Research proxy only; formal production eligibility and liquidity gates are not evaluated.

S2.name: pullback
S2.trigger: Range touches MA20 +/- 0.5*ATR14 and C>=MA20 and C>priorHigh

S3.name: panel_relative_momentum
S3.schedule: Friday close only; skip holiday Fridays rather than infer week end from future observations
S3.trigger: At least 5 panel members with 240 bars on the date; top ceil(N*0.20) by C[t-21]/C[t-126]-1; positive score and C>MA60

S4.name: contraction
S4.trigger: Prior-session WilderATR5/WilderATR20<=0.60 on the preceding 239 bars; C>=nextTick(prior10High), volume>=prior20MeanVolume and C>MA60

S5.name: revenue_acceleration
S5.hypothesis: New release: positive trailing-three-month YoY growth, accelerating at least 10 percentage points over preceding nonoverlapping three-month YoY growth, with C>MA60
S5.activation: Not enabled by current prices, article text or synthetic events; requires a separately reviewed future registry.

S7.name: broker_revision
S7.reason: Missing PIT broker/analyst forecast revisions, access rights and original-publication lineage
S7.hypothesis: Upward same-analyst, same-period, same-currency EPS revision may predict continuation; no numeric threshold is searched in this blocked round
S7.agent_event_interface: research_event_contract('S7'); source records only, never automatic strategy activation

execution.first_eligible_time: next official market session opening; never signal close
execution.entry_order: Precommitted opening limit ROD, cancel residual after opening assumed; no inferred intraday fills
execution.entry_lower: Descriptive plan boundary only: opening limit may fill below it. Do not inspect open then pretend to place at that same open.
execution.avoid_chase: Invalid stop/lower/upper geometry or signal close above upper emits no executable buy_limit
execution.exit: Closing MA/stop/time conditions queue next-tradable-session opening sale; S6 uses close>=MA5, others close<MA. No daily-bar intraday stop fill.
execution.same_bar: No same-day stop fill after opening entry; closing exit signals execute no earlier than the next session
execution.untradable: Missing opening/status authority, zero volume, locked limit-up buys and locked limit-down sells do not receive invented fills
execution.position_policy: Long only; no leverage, no averaging, one position per symbol; higher rank first, then symbol ascending
execution.corporate_action_execution: First real run permits verified cash-only events share_factor==1; other actions excluded before performance. Dividends lacking payment date are receivables, not spendable cash.

assumptions.sizing: Before observing opening prices: use previous-close NAV, prior20 turnover and each precommitted buy limit to fix lot quantities, including commission. Reserve cash for all ordered quantities before the opening. Do not reuse same-opening sale proceeds or refund gap-price savings into other opening orders.

benchmark.primary_limitation: Fully invested broad index versus partial-investment survivor-panel strategy; not an exposure/risk-matched alpha comparison.
benchmark.additional: Same eligible panel, initial buy-and-hold allocation up to 10% per stock, same friction/lot/liquidity/corporate-action assumptions, remaining cash; no rebalancing.
benchmark.unavailable: If official total-return data are unavailable, report missing; never silently replace with a price index.

acceptance.inference: No alpha, generalization, genuine OOS or causal claim from selected survivors and descriptive development windows.

cost_source_note: 0.1425% is the reference standard rate, not a universal legal ceiling; minimum TWD20 is an explicit model assumption.
preregistration_review_correction: Before any actual development performance was computed, independent implementation review aligned this registry to one continuous descriptive portfolio path, explicit primary/additional benchmarks, cost-addback terminology and pre-opening cash-reserved limit-based sizing. This is a pre-results contract correction, not a performance-driven parameter change.
